title: Scenario Specification Schema V9.2 (Chat Refactor)
description: Game scenario structure V9.2 with refactored Chat system, Passwords, Item Effects and Character Actions.

config.description: General configuration for the game scenario.

minTransition.description: Minimum transition time between scenes unit seconds

maxCharacterMoving.description: Maximum characters moving active. If characters moving active is greater than this value, it will queue list active moving.

maxInventory.description: Maximum inventory items (eg: [50, char_id], [20, char_id]). If [] to infinite.

maxHandOn.description: Maximum hand on items. If 0 to infinite.

brokenDisable.description: Disable use broken items or not.

minCharacterMoving.description: Minimum character moving time unit seconds.

stopEffectWhenChat.description: Stop effect when chat window is open.

defaultNotice.description: Enable default notice in hardcore on engine or not.

allDescRead.description: Force players to wait for descriptions on actions.

meta.description: General information about the game scenario.

entryScene.description: ID of the first Scene when starting the game.

entryCharacter.description: ID of the Character that the player will roleplay as initially.

globalStates.description: Global variables storing game state (flags, counters...).

templates.description: Shared template library (Requirements, Effects, Automations) for reuse.

moveDirection.description: Direction of movement: first or last.

runInfinity.description: Whether to run infinitely. If true, skip numberCycleAllow.

banClick.description: Whether to ban clicks during automation. Be careful with this setting with runInfinity true because it can cause an infinite loop.

plan.description: List of steps in the automation.

itemInfo.description: Database of items in the game.

icon.description: Display icon (Emoji or text Metarial Icon of Google).

status.description: Status of the item is an array of [value percents, label].

autoInc.description: Auto increment usage current value when used.

stats.description: Secondary stats of the item (Damage, Recovery...).

passwords.description: Definitions of passwords separated by keyspaces.

media.description: Definition of media resources (Photo, Video, Sound).

actions.description: Global list of Actions referenced by Routers.

loop.description: Whether the chat loops or is one-time.

sender.description: Character ID of sender, or null for unknown/spam.

block.description: Dictionary of dialogue blocks keyed by Block ID.

choice_id.description: Reference to a key in the choice object.

choiced.description: State: Has this block been completed/selected?

choice.description: Dictionary of choices keyed by Choice ID.

jump.description: Block ID to jump to. If null or duplicate with choice that Block ID contains it or not met, ends chat.

linkEffect.description: If true: Stats changes persist to this character when switching bodies.

mainAction.description: ID of the main action for this character.

nextStep.description: Seconds to wait before next move.

count.description: Count down for random_count. -1 is infinite.

effect.description: Character interaction effects keyed by Target Character ID.

meeting.description: Map of Character ID to Effect List. Run when this Character meets another Character.

leave.description: Map of Character ID to Effect List. Run when this Character leaves another Character.

met.description: List of characters met and count. Format: 'char_id:count'.

relationship.description: Relationship tags with other characters [[tag, char_id]].

place.description: Current Place ID where the character is standing.

scene_id.description: Current scene ID of the place.

runnable_wrapper.description: Wrapper for all logic actions (Effect, Requirement, Manage Effect).

target.description: ID of the object to check.

inline.description: Content to inject (for manage_effect add_effect). Note: originally 'content' in wrapper.

id.description: Unique ID for the effect instance. If duplicate, overrides existing.

flicker.description: Flicker interval in seconds (for overlay). If < 2, null or empty -> false.

loopSecond.description: Loop interval in seconds (for frame). If < 1, null or empty -> false.

id.description: ID of the target object (Character or Router).

desc.description: Description or hint for the password.

timer.description: Time limit in seconds. 0 means no limit.

value.description: The correct number combination. Use string to preserve leading zeros.

hint.description: Indices of characters to reveal as hint.

street.description: The ordered list of coordinates representing the correct path.

url.description: URL to the external puzzle resource.

ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the puzzle [width, height].

value.description: Correct combination (e.g. '0123'). Each digit represents a switch state.

activeRouterId.description: Router ID to activate immediately upon entering Scene.

routers.description: List of Routers (status, viewpoint) in the Scene.

secondsStill.description: Wait time before triggering Still Loop (seconds).

timerDisplay.description: Timer display: counting down (dec) or up (inc).

timerEnd.description: Action on timeout: Run loop (still) or exit (out).

overlayFlick.description: Duration in seconds for overlay flicker. If <= 1 or null/false, no flicker (permanent).

loop.description: Events automatically running per router lifecycle.

end.description: Run when Timer ends (if timerEnd = still).

actions.description: List of Action IDs available in this router.

password.description: Reference to password ID in 'type_pass:password_id' format.

charAllow.description: List of Character IDs permitted to execute this action.

clickHintDesc.description: Number of clicks before showing hint.

requirement.description: Requirement to execute action (if set.requirement = true).
